change_summary: App-only successor to v101.52; the corpus is unchanged and still matches the v101.52 contract. Fixes an iPad layout defect Louis reported on the Approfondir screen: the bottom navigation covered the end of the view and the text could not be scrolled any further. Cause: html.ios-device .content is a flex column with overflow-y:auto, and iOS Safari excludes such a container's padding-bottom from its scrollable overflow, so the 84-104px reserved for the bar evaporated on device while Chrome honoured it - which is why it only ever appeared on iPad. The space is now reserved by a ::after flex-item spacer, which is laid out in flow and always counted in scrollable overflow; the padding is zeroed on iOS so the two cannot add up. Measured in-browser with the iPad runtime class applied: scroll range 146px -> 177px and the last card clears the bar by 53px.
